reasons.seconds_maximum: How long the request that erases a creature goes on telling the societies that run it, read from the server's clock before each one; the societies it has not reached by then are left to tell themselves, which each does before its next minute (SocietyRepository.tell_of_erased_kinds). So the figure decides only how soon a society that is not running reads as told, never whether an erased creature is run again: it is not. Telling one society composes its whole next input, which for a town reads its place; what that takes was not measured for this figure. Two seconds is a wait a person accepts on a button that erases; a host with many worlds a workspace may lower it to 0, which tells none inline, and nothing is lost.
